metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic, heartwarming adventure about friendship and dragons, perfect for fans of Kung Fu Panda and Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: Since you loved Monsters, Inc., you will have a blast seeing how Mike and Sulley first met and became best friends in college.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious and clever twist on the superhero genre, filled with the same laugh-out-loud comedy found in Shrek.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A colorful, fast-paced video game adventure that matches the high energy and creativity of The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: From the creators of Despicable Me and Migration, this movie offers a hilarious look at what pets do when their owners leave for the day.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An incredibly silly and imaginative comedy about a machine that makes food fall from the sky like rain.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: A heartwarming, funny, and universally loved family comedy about a polite little bear who brings joy to everyone he meets.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful Disney-Pixar film about friendship and summer fun in Italy, carrying the same sweet charm as Ponyo.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An action-packed and deeply touching adventure featuring Baymax, a lovable inflatable robot, perfect for fans of action-comedy films.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: Since you loved the first Despicable Me, you will love following Gru and his Minions on another hilarious secret agent mission.

metas.name: WALL-E
metas.description: A visually spectacular Pixar masterpiece about a lonely little robot on a big space adventure, sharing the heart of Toy Story.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A magnificent, colorful balloon-filled journey that captures the incredible adventure and emotion of films like Inside Out.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A classic, clever Pixar adventure about a brave ant trying to save his colony, perfect for fans of Toy Story.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A fantastic superhero family adventure that delivers the same high-flying excitement as Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A magical, modern fantasy quest about two brothers that fans of Shrek and Brave will absolutely adore.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: You've seen the sequel, now enjoy the magical original movie that started the global phenomenon of Anna and Elsa's sisterly bond.

metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: Since you enjoyed Inside Out 2, go back and see how Joy, Sadness, and the original emotions first learned to work together.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A wildly funny, visually stunning family road-trip movie that has the same quirky energy as Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Continue Po's amazing journey as he discovers a secret village of pandas and teaches them how to fight.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A classic Pixar film filled with humor, friendship, and fast-paced fun that kids of all ages will love.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: An incredibly creative and fast-moving comedy where everything is awesome, perfect for fans of the Sonic the Hedgehog movies.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: An exciting and funny Disney adventure about a heroic TV star dog who accidentally gets lost in the real world.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A breathtakingly beautiful adventure about a young girl helping a magical Yeti return to his family on Mount Everest.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: From the same creative minds as Wallace & Gromit, this is a brilliantly funny, dialogue-free adventure full of slapstick humor.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: Since you watched Simba's Pride and Mufasa, experience the ultimate Disney masterpiece that started it all.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A hilarious and visually stunning DreamWorks comedy about a prehistoric family exploring a wild and colorful new world.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: This beautifully animated Studio Ghibli film is based on 'The Borrowers', making it the perfect match for your movie tastes.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A delightful and whimsical Studio Ghibli fantasy about a girl who travels to a magical kingdom populated entirely by cats.

metas.name: Night at the Museum
metas.description: A thrilling and magical live-action adventure comedy about museum exhibits coming to life, similar to Matilda and Sonic.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A clever and hilarious fairytale comedy about a cartoon princess who gets sent to the real world of New York City.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A heartwarming Disney classic about a lonely girl who adopts an unruly alien creature, sharing the same family theme as Turning Red.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud animal adventure about zoo animals who find themselves stranded in the wild, perfect for fans of Ice Age and Rio.

metas.name: The Princess and the Frog
metas.description: A magical, music-filled Disney fairytale adventure set in New Orleans, with the same vibrant energy as Tangled.

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: A high-flying, magical carpet ride full of unforgettable songs and the hilarious, fast-talking Genie.

metas.name: Peter Pan
metas.description: A classic, whimsical Disney fantasy adventure to Never Land that has enchanted kids for generations.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: More hilarious Minion mayhem and family fun as Gru discovers he has a long-lost, cheerful twin brother named Dru.

metas.name: Ice Age: The Meltdown
metas.description: Since you enjoyed the original Ice Age, join Manny, Sid, and Diego on another funny and chaotic escape from a melting glacier.

metas.name: Epic
metas.description: A thrilling forest adventure about a girl shrunk down into a hidden world of tiny warriors, echoing themes from The Borrowers.

metas.name: Mary Poppins
metas.description: A legendary, magical musical family film about a whimsical nanny that fans of Matilda and Annie will absolutely cherish.

metas.name: Babe
metas.description: A charming and wonderfully sweet family movie about an adorable little pig who learns to herd sheep.
